ohneb_afk_cinematics.automatic.help: Start after a period without input while standing still.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.delay.help: Seconds without activity before a cinematic starts. Use the arrow keys for fine adjustment.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.lens.help: Cinematic frames more tightly. Wide shows more of the surroundings. Game setting uses your normal field of view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.fps.help: A separate frame cap during cinematics. Normal FPS settings resume on exit. Arrow keys adjust by 1 FPS. VSync and hardware can still limit the actual frame rate.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.hideHud.help: Hide the hotbar and other HUD elements during cinematics.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.hidePlayerNames.hel: Hide player name tags and scoreboard labels during cinematics.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.letterbox.help: Add black bars above and below the view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.music.help: Play Minecraft music during cinematics. Respects your music volume and lets existing tracks finish.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.unfocused.help: Allow cinematics while unfocused, using the cinematic FPS cap. Paused or minimized windows keep their normal behaviour.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.preview.help: Stand still in a world to preview. Move to return to the normal camera.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.unavailable: Stand still with no menu open to start a cinematic.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.no_view: No clear view nearby. Try another spot or enable more shot types.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.save_error: Could not save settings. Check the config folder permissions.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.read_error: Settings could not be read. The existing file has been preserved.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.scroll: Scroll or use Page Up / Page Down for more settings.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.motion.help: Gentle motion, smaller movements, or a still view after entry.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.subject: Subject
ohneb_afk_cinematics.subject.help: Mixed balances player and scenery shots using your preferred player share. Scenery uses nearby loaded terrain only.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.playerShare.help: Preferred player share in Mixed mode. Unavailable views fall back to the other subject. Player and Scenery modes ignore this setting.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.pace.help: %s to %s seconds per shot. Longer shots move more slowly.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shots.help: Choose the shots in the rotation. At least one must stay enabled.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.arc.help: A slow arc around the subject.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.diagonal_glide: Travel forward and sideways through the view with a steady heading.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.rising_pass.he: Climb gently while flying forward through the scenery.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.descending_pas: Descend on a steady forward approach.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.pull_away.help: Fly backward while keeping the same heading to reveal a wider view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.dolly.help: Move gently toward or away from the subject.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.crane.help: A gentle vertical move with a little sideways drift.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.overhead.help: Look down over scenery when the ceiling is clear. Not used for player shots.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.flyover.help: A level aerial drive across the view. Scenery keeps a steady heading rather than circling one point.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.low_pass.help: Track close to the ground or canopy, where the full path is clear.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.reveal.help: Pull back and rise in one continuous move to reveal the surroundings.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.pan.help: Hold position while slowly turning across the view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shots.title: Shot types
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.fly_through.he: Travel forward through the scenery with a steady heading, over canopies, near the ground or underwater.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.traverse.help: A broad sideways drive that keeps its heading and lets the environment move through the frame.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shots.last: Enable another shot before turning this one off.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.boats.help: Follow boats and rafts. Start manually while steering, or let the idle timer start a passenger view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.flight.help: Follow Elytra and creative flight. Landing, damage and invalid views return control.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.travelControls.help: Keep movement and mouse look active in manually started boat and flight cinematics. Toggle or Escape exits. Automatic cinematics still wake on input.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.trail.help: Follow a boat or flight from an angled position behind the player.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.escort.help: Track a boat or flight from the side, letting the landscape pass behind it.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.lead.help: Film a boat or flight from an oblique position ahead of the player.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.wide_track.hel: Pull higher and farther out to show the journey and surrounding terrain.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.fishing.help: Start a view when your bobber lands in water. Look around and reel normally. Waking keeps that cast in your hands until you start another view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.angler.help: A broad sideways view of the angler, line and surrounding bank.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.cast_line.help: Glide past the angler with the fishing line leading out into the water.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.float.help: Look back across the float toward the angler and shoreline, just above the water.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.low_escort.hel: Follow near the waterline or just below a flyer, with the landscape passing behind them.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.high_trail.hel: Follow from high behind the journey, leaving room for the landscape ahead.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.broadside.help: Track the journey in profile with space in front of the player.
